name: Count
source:
The oldest vampire. [spoiler]Lilith's descendant. [/spoiler]

Powerful and dignified. Doesn't care about other vampires. [spoiler]Focused only on his mission.[/spoiler]

[i]"He was a tempest. There were vampires who tried to overflow certain lands with thralls. Yet he appeared before them, condemned their act, and left.

He was a blaze. There were vampires who pulled the strings of certain countries from the shadows and indulged in luxury. Yet he overthrew them and vanished in the darkness.

He was a lightning. There were vampires who dyed a certain castle in the blood of young maidens every night. Yet he appeared and put an end to their madness along with them.

A merciless god, appearing from nowhere to bring a judgement for those who are haughty with immortal lives, imagining themselves night overlords, and yielding souls to their desires."[/i]

[Translated from in-game narration]
